How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages-based digital commerce platform is built around a simple yet powerful concept: using a static website generator like Jekyll or Hugo to create a website that showcases your digital products, and then using a backend logic service like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle transactions and payment processing.
